facts.text: In my town everything has a price and every meal has rules. Barter first, then eat.
facts.why: Aunty Entity never says this. It is printed in quote marks. Her real lines include 'Bust a deal and face the Wheel!'
facts.fix: Bust a deal and face the Wheel!

fix_note.text: Bust a deal and face the Wheel!
